en_title: Halo Special Edition Xbox Console Hallmark Keepsake Ornament Is Now Available
subtitle: 迷你主机也有启动音
opus_summary: Hallmark推出《光环》特别版XBOX主机圣诞挂饰，由亚马逊独家发售。挂饰还原半透明绿色主机与手柄，支持亮灯并播放启动音效及《光环2》音乐，附带三颗纽扣电池。

paragraphs.en: Every year, Hallmark releases hundreds of new Christmas ornaments, including some very cool ones based on video games and geek culture . This year, as an Amazon-exclusive release that just went live, you can get the Xbox Halo Special Edition Console Hallmark Keepsake Ornament ( see it at Amazon ). The ornament is a miniature version of the translucent green Halo-themed special edition Xbox console Microsoft released in 2004. It’s available now for $27.99.
paragraphs.cn: Hallmark每年都会推出数百款新圣诞挂饰，其中不乏以电子游戏和极客文化为主题的酷炫款式。今年，Hallmark Keepsake系列的《光环》特别版XBOX主机挂饰刚刚在亚马逊独家上架（可在亚马逊查看）。这款挂饰将微软于2004年推出的半透明绿色《光环》主题特别版XBOX主机缩小还原，现已开售，售价27.99美元(约合人民币187元)。

paragraphs.en: The ornament looks just like a tiny version of the real thing. It has the chunky rectangular console, decked out in translucent green plastic and the words “Halo Special Edition” on the front right. It also has an adorable little cord leading to a similarly green original Xbox controller sitting on the console.
paragraphs.cn: 这款挂饰看上去就是实物的迷你版：厚实的长方形主机采用半透明绿色塑料外壳，正面右侧印着「Halo Special Edition」字样。主机上还放着一只同样为绿色的初代XBOX手柄，用一根可爱的小线缆与主机相连。

paragraphs.en: It’s also a “Magic Light and Sound” ornament, meaning it, well, lights up and makes sound. When you press the tiny Power button on the ornament, the light comes on and it plays the console startup sound and music from " Halo Theme Mjolnir Mix " from Halo 2.
paragraphs.cn: 它还是一款「Magic Light and Sound」挂饰，也就是说，嗯，它会亮灯，也会发声。按下挂饰上小小的电源键，灯光就会亮起，同时播放主机启动音效，以及《光环2》中的《Halo Theme Mjolnir Mix》音乐。

paragraphs.en: Also included are the three Alkaline LR44 button batteries required to make it light up and play music. And the size in inches is 3.5 x 1.25 x 3.5, so it's a small thing (you know, the size of a standard Christmas ornament). I have the SNES Hallmark Keepsake Ornament, and I love it.
paragraphs.cn: 包装内还附带三颗LR44碱性纽扣电池，供挂饰亮灯和播放音乐使用。挂饰尺寸为3.5×1.25×3.5英寸，约合8.89×3.18×8.89厘米，所以体积很小（就是普通圣诞挂饰的大小）。我自己有一款Hallmark Keepsake系列的SNES挂饰，非常喜欢。

paragraphs.en: If you’re interested in an original Xbox Christmas ornament but you're not particularly keen on the Halo Special Edition, you can purchase a standard Xbox Hallmark Keepsake Ornament instead ( see it at Amazon ). It debuted in 2024 but is still available and still looks like a perfectly tiny version of Microsoft’s original game console.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你想买一款初代XBOX圣诞挂饰，但对《光环》特别版不太感兴趣，也可以选择Hallmark Keepsake系列的标准版XBOX挂饰（可在亚马逊查看）。这款挂饰于2024年推出，目前仍在销售，看上去依然是微软初代游戏主机的精巧迷你版。

paragraphs.en: Alternately, a bunch more gaming ornaments came out this year, including a Halo Warthog, as well as Pokémon, Zelda, and more. Fans of other classic consoles can pick up a rather excellent PS1 ornament , perhaps to complement their PlayStation LEGO set ?
paragraphs.cn: 此外，今年还推出了不少其他游戏主题挂饰，包括《光环》的疣猪号，以及《宝可梦》《塞尔达》等主题款式。喜欢其他经典主机的玩家也可以买一款相当出色的PS1挂饰，或许还能和自己的PlayStation乐高套装搭配一下？

paragraphs.en: In similar news, Microsoft is releasing a new translucent green version of the Xbox Series X on November 13. However, only 25,000 of these special edition consoles are being made, and it has already sold out everywhere it went up for preorder. You may be able to get one at release, if more stock becomes available.
paragraphs.cn: 另一则相关消息是，微软将于11月13日推出全新的半透明绿色版XBOX Series X。不过，这款特别版主机仅生产25,000台，所有开启预购的渠道都已售罄。如果届时有更多库存放出，你或许能在发售时买到一台。
